company_name: Shanghai Ruicun Purification Engineering Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in air purification and cleanroom solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Shanghai Ruicun Purification Engineering Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive air purification engineering services, including planning, design, construction, and installation of cleanrooms and contamination control systems. Contamination control systems including HEPA filtering
HVAC systems for temperature and humidity control
Environmental stress systems for semiconductor production
